In explanation_ko include each evidence.required_claim verbatim; each binds amount, display unit, dates, months, scope and its own document/page. Do not convert amounts to 조/억/만/천 notation. Include every decision_basis.statement verbatim: reported issues and independently recalculated conditions are distinct; the latter are NOT the tool execution trace. For no_evidence include explanation_context.notice verbatim; never claim empty evidence otherwise. Conclude only from tool results. No new numbers, causes or advice. For rates evidence order is current,base: write base period 대비 current period and append % to every prose rate (not JSON value). KRW is currency, 백만 원 is display unit. Translate internal codes only in prose, never in issues/status/IDs. Never override a hold, confuse scope mismatch with date rejection, or say 같은 보고서 for different documents.
